_comment: Example RBB scenario config for Ibex. Run: 1) launch the RBB-mode sim (make -C ../../../ibex_sim soc_openocd, or scripts/launch_rbb_benchmark.sh which drives a benchmark instead of this scenario) 2) pydebug run --config ibex_halt_over_rbb.json, from a cwd where 'openocd_bitbang_ibex.cfg' resolves -- e.g. ../../../ibex_sim.
